title: Work package review verdict
description: The reviewer's final message. package.ps1 review validates it and then checks it against what the host observed; the schema alone proves neither inspection nor correctness.

reviewedCommit.description: The full commit id that was reviewed. Must equal the head the host observed.

reviewedTree.description: The git tree id of that commit. Must equal the tree the host observed.

verdict.description: PASS only when every criterion is pass and no finding is blocking.

criteria.description: One entry per criterion of the brief (C1, C2, ...), each exactly once.

evidence.description: What was inspected or run, with file:line or the command.

scenario.description: A concrete input or sequence that shows the problem.

omissions.description: What the reviewer did not inspect or could not run.
